body: Yeah - we should give a proper error message here.

@salvatore-campagna that error would be difficult for the user to debug. It would change based on which shards were hit first right? Since the fields are a disjoint set, the field would be on one shard, but not on another. 

So, we should indicate that all fields need to exist in all indices or something.
This is definitely a "bad request" as the documentation is clear that the fields must all co-exist in the same docs.

issue.title: fix: check field existence before trying to merge running stats

repository.name: elasticsearch
repository.description: Free and Open Source, Distributed, RESTful Search Engine

issue.body:
All fields must co-hexist in the same docs for the stats to be
calculated correctly. As a result, we need to check existence of
the fields before trying to merge running stats.

Instead of collecting all field names into a collection we decided
to extract the field names from one of the maps. This saves us from
serializing/deserializing another collection and some backward
compatibility pain. This means also that we assume all maps
to hold the same set of keys and just chose one of them as the
candidate to extract keys (field names) from.

This is a fix for issue #73276.
